text: knows Goblin history better than Rags
unnamed fat Hob, eats pine needles, no [Shaman] so no name; shielded Rags from Garen's sword
once lived in this mountain and left; speaks common; refuses Rags's order to ingratiate himself with the Redfang mace Hob
says he is "not smart", cannot be Lord, and does not want it
leads an attack on Tremborag's Goblins with Hobs sent by Rags
wounded in the belly and arm; chews sticks and rocks to keep teeth sharp, tells Rags the Human women could not survive alone
pulls her out; less than a hundred Goblins died in the zombie fight
Hobgoblin, former Chieftain of a small mining tribe (called Goldstone Chieftain); Rags's second-in-command; eats soap, rocks, bark, coal; stays awake nights
a farmer with a pitchfork stabbed him in his first memory; he thinks in smells and cannot write
wonders about Goblin King Velan the Kind, Tremborag's giant form, and a key-like object Garen showed Tremborag
throws Goblins into the lake to lift morale; throws Rags too, who swims well
assumes the nearby town sent the adventurers who killed the Undercrawlers, though there is no proof
first composes verses ("The wretched few gather", "We are not monsters yet") and dreams of Goblins at peace with other races and of Rags becoming Goblin King

drowns a Rose Knight in the lake, breaks his axe on one, nearly killed by arrows and a frost dagger

Rags's fat, taciturn second-in-command, eats insects and dandelions, and is respected by all factions
beats up six Hobs and nine Goblins from Tremborag's mountain who assault Welca

kills no one but wins a Human knight's gratitude and an opening for talks
explains he does not kidnap or rape, and that his tribe raided caravans and one settlement, killing none, unlike the Mountain City tribe
says a Human town killed Goblin adults and children, and the Goblins killed an equal number of Humans, having counted them
says Goblins want only to live, and says peace is possible ("Maybe?")
former Chieftain of the Goldstone Tribe, which never fought Humans and gathered gold stones for fun
carries a hemp sack of cut and polished gems and eats soap and wax paper; trades a gold nugget to a Goblin child for tadpoles
uses gems as "Human bait" thrown at attacking armies
gives Welca a polished cobalt sapphire the size of an egg and Kerrig a piece of turquoise
asks the Knights how magic works and wants to know what it "wants"
wants to be a [Mage], not a [Shaman], because Humans kill Goblin mages first
chews a topaz, says "Sink", and turns the ground to mud so he and Welca sink to the waist
kills the Human captain with the fiery battleaxe and orders no pursuit as Rags said
at a crossroads decide to go south toward Liscor and keep watching Kerrig
says Kerrig wants to learn and thinks Goblins are like people
Hob with an enchanted flaming battleaxe; wins a skirmish at the cauldrons and holds Redscar back as second in command
tells Bethal "Tears are a waste of water" and "We are not the Goblin Lord army"
takes command while Rags is unconscious, repels Unseen Empire raids for three days; takes five or more arrows
refuses healing potions to conserve them; reasons the Humans' sight is a Skill, then learns the totems are the cause
sends eighty Goblins in pairs with axes and torches to destroy totems and find stragglers
discovers the totems are the Humans' eyes
sets pikes (twenty-foot, drilled by Rags), 100 Hobs and Redfangs disguised among pike Goblins; calls for backs to the broken walls
battleaxe is enchanted and sets foes and clubs aflame
tells Kerrig and Welca Caveis that his tribe doesn't fight Humans, now judges that untrue

fat Hob with an enchanted battleaxe, identified as a probable Chieftain; Tyrion's monocle with [Appraisal] shows Rags has nearly as many Chieftain levels and Redscar has [Raid Leader] and none in Chieftain
killed forty-three Humans in the battle before reinforcements arrived
nicknamed his thing "small" to Reiss; a glowing enchanted battleaxe
revealed to have been taught by Greydath; Tremborag is stunned
former [Mining Chieftain] of the Goldstone Tribe; class [Blademaster] Level 3 taught by Greydath; skills for finding gemstones and a lost teleporting citrine
roasts rats found by his gem-finding skill and shares them with Eater of Spears
leads a Hob charge, cutting through the goats with his enchanted fiery battleaxe despite being bitten, and proves his strength to the Mountain City Hobs
can anticipate a blow's direction by reading muscles, taught by Greydath, not a Skill
throws Eater of Spears' axes, severing Reiss's hand
privately doubts Greydath's teachings about Goblin Kings and Velan
becomes known as Rags' strong second-in-command
wades through Reiss's army with his enchanted battleaxe, blocks [Deathbolt] with the metal, and cuts Reiss's chest
survived by eating magic gemstones to absorb [Deathbolt]; gains class [Magestone Chieftain] and makes a gem glow
seemingly dead then alive, new class [Magestone Chieftain]
left Tremborag's mountain at about age five after a fight with Greydath, founded the Mountain Fierce Warriors Tribe, was crushed by Humans and gave up on being Goblin Lord
blocks the mountain slope, wounds Tyrion and kills several Humans before dying
dies holding the mountain slope
body found and head buried on the hillside
Goldstone Chieftain who guessed memory-passing could work and tried it on Numbtongue
Goldstone Chieftain whose class consolidated into [Magestone Chieftain]; could cut gems and used them; carved an emerald for Stickhair
wakes in Numbtongue's body for a minute and scratches questions into the floor, ending with "Find the others if they remain. Find our King."
speaks briefly through Numbtongue for the first time since his death
eats pickled fish, carves a smoky quartz marble with [Rock Polishing] and [Miner's Claws] and gives it to Mrsha
speaks through Numbtongue and tests the Skill on a chair leg
Pyrite is dead, "impaled-dead. Sacrifice death"
death confirmed to the Greystone Chieftain
blind from birth, from San Francisco, arrives holding a bacon quiche and a fiberglass cane; best friend Zoe
about 184 cm; parents a lawyer and a businessman; wanted to be a chef, critic, billiards player
tells villagers he is a traveler sidetracked by a spell
model for his class is Emperor Norton I of San Francisco
declares himself Emperor of the Unseen and Protector of Durene's House; gains [Emperor Class Obtained!], [Emperor Level 1!], [Skill - Aura of the Emperor]
finds a sack with 141 gold coins and 8 gemstones buried in the snow
believes [King's Bounty] produced the gold
trusts Durene's description that Skills grow stronger above Level 30
reaches [Emperor Level 2] on Day 19 after teaching Durene and tending the cottage
[Aura of the Emperor] first works when he shouts "Enough" in anger, driving the children off
[Emperor Level 4!] and [Skill - King's Bounty obtained!] on learning Durene is half-Troll
become lovers
blind from birth; sleeps apart from Durene on the floor of her cottage; has lived with her about a month
sees the area around Durene's cottage as a circle he can sense, claimed as his demesne as an [Emperor]
[Emperor] sense detects squirrel dens and things within his domain, but not the creature's species
gains [Skill - Lesser Bond: Frostwing] and [Beast Tamer] Level 1 at [Emperor] Level 5; Level 2 on Day 31 night
[Emperor] Level 6 and [Skill - Intimidating Glare] on Day 34; [Emperor] Level 7 on Day 38; [Beast Tamer] Level 4 by Day 38
has a bag of coins found by accident, about a hundred times what he spent; Durene hid it behind a sack
titles granted to faeries include Comtesse of the Soup Spoon, Reichsgräfin, Duchess, Viscount, a score of Blumenritter, one Baron
faeries partly refuse to tell him of coming misfortune, saying they wanted to see him "before it was too late"
avalanche triggered possibly by snow, sound or faeries buries the forest but splits around the cottage
cannot sense beyond Durene's cottage radius without claiming new land; carried by Durene who runs ten minutes' distance in four
first claim fails when spoken; he needs the permission of the previous owner, as Durene gave for her cottage
shouts "My name is Laken Godart! I claim this village!" and declares Riverfarm a Protectorate of the Unseen Empire
after the claim senses a boy trapped fifteen feet down and supervises villagers' digging; uses CPR on Sic, who revives; teaches mouth to mouth and compressions
finds root cellars, stores, shovels, a sword, broken bows and potions by sensing; orders fires and soup
no longer goads villagers; his thunder voice silences fighting villagers as when he silenced children tormenting Durene
iPhone in his pocket, flashlight app installed by his friend Zoe; plays L'hymne a l'amour and Viertel vor Sieben
[Emperor] Level 9 and [Skill - Empire: Blessing of the Hearth]
unsure whether this world is destiny; wonders whether it could be home
has hundreds of gold coins; plans to take Durene, Frostwing, Gamel and a wagon to Invrisil to buy food and guards
tells villagers Riverfarm is Emperor's dominion; they call him Emperor
swears to return to Riverfarm as his home
blind, eyes closed, in Invrisil with Durene, a seven-foot half-Troll; an adventurer insults them; Laken's order "Enough" presses on Ryoka's chest
curses the lieutenant in German; Ryoka recognizes the language
blind, calls himself an [Emperor]; says he gained a form of sight; is in Invrisil for the people under his protection
guesses the thief had a Skill to pick wealthy marks
first contact between Earth natives; Laken realizes he is "not alone"
tells Ryoka he and Durene are a couple; Durene almost broke Ryoka's fingers shaking hands
[Emperor]; his presence makes crowds notice him and servants feel urged to bow; Reynold likens it to standing before Lady Reinhart or Lord Veltras only stronger
chose those teams because they were the only two that did not mock Gamel's plea
tells Merec he cannot be lied to, though he admits privately he has no way to tell
succeeds in buying supplies and hiring two adventuring teams for Riverfarm
24, half German and raised in Europe; Ryoka is 21; Erin is 20
says "Ich bin ein [Kaiser]", reveals he is an [Emperor]; tells Ryoka frost faeries helped Durene's cottage during an avalanche and he knighted a few
speak of a summoning spell in Rhir behind their arrival
proposes Wistram broadcast "come home" in many languages with Earth-only verification questions, and warns against extremists; BlackMage agrees; call ends on Laken's order
says gods are unproven but Ryoka reports a sleeping God
reveals to Ryoka that he is an [Emperor]
speak with BlackMage, learning Wistram is hunting Earthlings
gives Durene her first Christmas present, a clumsily wrapped box; she weeps
blind [Emperor], also a [Beast Tamer], travelling in a wagon to Riverfarm with Durene and Gamel; hired the Silver-rank Windfrozen Riders and another Silver team
blind [Emperor] and [Beast Tamer] who left a different world; owns Riverfarm and senses all land he claims, seeing outlines and expressions without colour or detail
his [Emperor] sense ends at the village boundary and he goes blind outside it
skill [Empire: Blessing of the Hearth] makes sleeping pleasant for his subjects
had spent about a week in Invrisil buying supplies, hiring fire-mages to clear roads and two Silver-rank teams at the Merchant's Guild
plans a rebuilt village with combined fields, a main road and permanent houses; the first houses are to be three built from forest timber
asks Prost to be his [Steward] and names him, saying he sees Prost has changed
gave Durene the [Paladin] class and wants her armed
halts the bear with a shouted command, then uses [Intimidating Glare] to order it back to the forest
invites Windrest's people to Riverfarm and plans more houses despite food limits
says he does not need honorifics because titles are meaningless to him
reveals he is an [Emperor] to the escort adventurers
realises the Mossbear arrived before his sense warned him, and that he needs a larger claim
offers Windrest refuge, inviting a refugee influx
tells the Windrest people they must obey him as ruler while in his domain, and swears to protect them
gains Emperor Level 10, [Empire: Low-born Militias] and [Rallying Presence]
can sense below ground; finds a rat tunnel network two feet down, and dogs of Windrest kill the rats Prost's farmers unearth
reaches Beast Tamer Level 5, then Level 7 with [Animals: Basic Command] after ordering rats out of the ground
has Beniar, Odveig and Wiskeria train villagers; Wiskeria to teach magic to those with aptitude, Beniar swordplay, and Durene to train personally; she has [Enhanced Strength]
orders trainees to run six laps, push-ups, sit-ups and burpees daily before sword training
senses someone in his cottage on Day 63; nothing is found missing and Frostwing screams
on Day 65 feeds the Mossbear a basket of fruit and meat at its cave, commands it to stop and befriends it
becomes Emperor Level 10
orders Odveig's Trackers to find the Goblins, Prost to build palisades, and no one to leave the village without escort
has been working on a way to see beyond the village that will take a few more days
touches the dead Goblin and compares it to a small child; he has never seen colour
says a blind man climbed the world's highest mountain and that he has met him
notes a worry at his own thought of crushing Rehanna
realises Odveig used a higher, elegant voice when whispering, unlike her accented speech
calls himself an idiot for losing a strong adventurer
suspects Magnolia sent a spy because Ryoka said she sent [Assassins] after her
Day 69, three attacks by Goblins left only wounded; Wiskeria leads the adventurers now and the relationship is strained
with six markers placed (the seventh abandoned) the hexagon opens in his senses and he perceives the forest, the sleeping Mossbear and the Goblins within it
his [Emperor] command "Stop" works only partly on a Goblin archer and fails to move a Hobgoblin much
says he tipped the Goblins off that they were coming
says he became an [Emperor] when he met Durene, inspired by a story of an Emperor with no crown
names Calop and Fulca as dying villagers and speaks of them as his subjects
commands Gamel to stand and live; speaks of fates burning together and withholds permission to die
offers Wiskeria the post of [General]; she accepts by taking his hand
his informant in Invrisil gave him advice such as the markers, Prost as [Steward] and Wiskeria as [General]
plans to make Gamel a [Knight] and offer Beniar [Captain] or armor-based classes
believes classes like [General], [Steward] and [Paladin] are rare and stronger than normal ones
reaches [Emperor] Level 15, gains Empire: Art of the Builder and Undying Loyalty
[Emperor], blind, senses everything within his territory via marker totems; rules Riverfarm, Windrest, Tunslaven, Kiquel and nearby; the Unseen Empire
[Beast Tamer] Level 9; [Lesser Bond: Unnamed Mossbear], rides the Mossbear as a throne; Frostwing is a young blue bird on his armguard
dubs [Knights] and has given away most [Lord]/[Lady] titles, including to Frost Faeries as [Baronesses], to save his village
uses the markers carved by Jelov (eye of providence symbol, eight feet tall); sees a limited area, markers fuzzy if too far apart
lives in Durene's cottage; lover of Durene; Riverfarm villagers approve
sends [Message] "I offer you the gift of swords"; battle with four hundred-plus soldiers; Laken says "Kneel" and "Look this way" to direct the fight
villagers and soldiers shout "The Emperor of Beasts"
reaches Emperor Level 19, gains [Imperial Levy] and [Empire: Darksky Riders]
learns of the alliance via Lady Rie; Tyrion is enraged; Erin hears the news
blind [Emperor] of the Unseen Empire from San Francisco; senses everything in his domain; sovereign of Riverfarm, Windrest, Tunslaven, Kiquel and others
his friend Zoe described Age of Empires II to him and he treats empire planning like a game
Skills [Blessing of the Hearth] (comfortable sleep), [Imperial Levy], [King's Bounty], [Lesser Bond: Bismarck]
has told only Durene he is from Earth; Ryoka objected to telling others, though he considers telling Wiskeria
aims to train [Engineers] and let children choose crafts, using communal farming
believes Sacra and Odveig are the same person
lies about his past to hide Earth origins, citing blindness for ignorance of etiquette
cannot judge fork quality by touch; feels his blindness a hindrance in hosting
realises the trap is conforming to noble custom, refuses the helmet and hall, seats Durene at the head table in a suit, and holds a standing outdoor feast with trebuchet demonstrations
posts notices that anyone abusing another person on his lands will be shot and executed
asks nobles to bring food, sweets and pudding, [Jugglers], [Bards], [Actors] as the host gift
confronts Horst and Wellim in the throne room; feud ends in fifteen minutes
phone is dead; Ryoka told him a [Repair] spell can recharge it
rides Bismarck to greet them, keeps his speech as plain "Laken Godart" without titles
believes the dreaming voices are real memories
stops dancing to Magnolia's tune and trusts his own approach
the first [Emperor] to appear on Izril in over a thousand years, Bevia says
rumoured to be blind but all-seeing, with a half-Giant bodyguard and a [Witch] general, bought supplies in Invrisil with gems and gold
greets arrivals while riding Bismarck and presents himself as "Laken Godart, Emperor of Riverfarm"
warns fae are neither enemies nor friends, no promises, no lies, stay in the meadow, cold iron hurts them, gold may turn to flowers
feels the fae as colours, first perception of green and blue
calls Durene his consort; swears to Bevia on a truth gem if needed that he will not seize other lands
passes Magnolia's test
recreated Franzbrötchen (cinnamon rolls) and cookies; first food from home he has recreated
map shows allied cities with flags, hostile ones as round stones; ally cities reachable by [Message] if they have a [Mage]
plan is to teach math, reading, writing and blueprints so anyone can build trebuchets and gain classes like [Engineer]
tells nobles to send surplus people to Riverfarm; they agree
believes Skills make people rely on instinct rather than understanding, so the world's technology never advances
senses many presences approaching in the distance and says "Scheiße", tells only Wiskeria and Beniar
feels hate and has enemies for the first time; says "She lied to me" and the plan will not change
nobles told Goblin Lord's army of about 8,000 is 42 miles north, raided by about 600 for 1,000 killed with under 100 casualties
reveals the Goblin threat to the nobles, trapping them in Riverfarm
swears to destroy the Goblins with traps and poison
tells nobles the Goblin Lord sent the army and it killed Filk's local army two days ago
directs raids from Riverfarm by [Message] via Nesor; Durene marches with the levied main army
loses sight of the area around the Goblin-held city, which is not his territory, and loses totems to Goblin axes
orders more markers carved by Jelov and guards posted by General Wiskeria
orders the city surrounded and bombarded with two trebuchets, asks that Durene be kept safe
the siege of the Goblin-held city begins with trebuchet fire
sees only the war camp by one totem; the totem network is collapsing under Goblin raids
orders Wiskeria to keep bombarding but hold the assault and send Kerrig to Riverfarm quickly
recalls tipping off Filk about a tribe of Goblins and begins to suspect the army from Filk was chasing them
first hears Rags's voice, a child's; says Skill lets him see though blind
refuses peace after his army fought; says "Someone ordered my army to assault your tribe"
grazed on the left cheek by Rags's bolt; Rags's second bolt kills Bevia's [Mage]
says a blind man's eyes stare at others until he blinks, so he closes them
reasons that fake [Message] spells are easy and wishes he had set a password; recalls a friend's warning that spies would be the least of his trials
sees the pattern of destroyed totems leading from the Goblins to Riverfarm and concludes Kerrig was followed
orders the Goblins killed, declining peace
orders soldiers to pursue the Goblins and Tyrion countermands him, saying he will deal with the Chieftain in two hours
says no noble leaves Riverfarm until questioned over who ordered his General to attack and who impersonated his mage; asks Prost for an axe
left south two days ago with Gamel, Tessia and over thirty villagers; a deal with Tyrion
blind [Emperor] of Riverfarm; stops Gralton's snarling with "Heel" and an aura
knows how to make trebuchets, has thirteen with eight tested and two [Engineers]; Tyrion conscripts craftsmen for twenty, maybe forty
blind outside his tent, his [Emperor] senses work only in the tent Tyrion gave him with Jelov totems; Gamel serves him as bodyguard and [Knight]

begin planning how to rescue Yitton's children; Laken names Lady Ieka and Lord Erill as nobles he distrusts
has a trebuchet volley "misfire" onto the back of the Goblin Lord's army
walks the battlefield and says "Live" to a dying Goblin; has Gamel leave a healing potion
claims a few hundred Goblin prisoners, forbids harm to them, and takes them north with Yitton and Gralton
went south to Liscor with Tyrion Veltras, taking the trebuchets, Tessia and the engineers; he holds hundreds of Goblin prisoners
tells Durene he loves her and is coming home
used poison gas in surprise attacks on Goblins and later attacked Liscor with trebuchets, per Ryoka and Durene
rides in the supply wagon behind the Goblin prisoner wagons, with Gamel (fiancee Tessia) as aide
gets a Message about Rehanna's cloth changeling and says Belavierr must be at least Level 40 per Yitton
orders a Message to Riverfarm to let no one bargain with Belavierr, to gather evidence for a trial he will preside over, and to be kind to Rehanna
senses Riverfarm as hot, like something hot is coming on the wind
asks Gralton to ride to his lands to bring his army if things worsen
a Message tells of Hedag's act which Yitton calls illegal and Laken praises as good
senses a beacon of light moving to Riverfarm, Gralton rides for his army, and Yitton orders the caravan to push through the night
gains a vision of light from Riverfarm for the first time
replies that he could not find the Hunters; orders no deals with Belavierr until he arrives
sends a [Message] that he cannot find the hunter on his lands but senses a Drake [Merchant] with scrolls and wings
caravan with Yitton Byres is too far away to reach Riverfarm in time; he tells Prost to retreat to the fields
returns Day 71; hugs Bismarck, kisses Durene and reaches Level 20, gaining [Surge of Inspiration] and [Fields of Bounty]
appoints Ram [Head Farmer], Beycalt [Construction Supervisor], names Gamel aide and [Knight], Durene consort and [Paladin], and tells the Lancrel Councilwoman Beatica she holds no authority
orders deer hunted eight miles north, seventeen refugee groups invited in by Beniar's Darksky Riders, and fifty-eight burned totems replaced
draws a line in the mud giving the Goblins land beside the river south of Riverfarm, leaving tools and a week of food and an iPhone in a crate on top of pillows
says in early spring he summoned the fae and Ivolethe told him she is alive but will never see Ryoka in this world
the blind [Emperor] of Riverfarm; senses all within his lands but not the Goblins' territory
draws a line in dirt, tells the Goblins that beyond it is his land; leaves crates of supplies and the iPhone
[Emperor] of the Unseen Empire at Riverfarm; two Silver teams went with him mid-winter and stayed
blind [Emperor] with an "empire-sense"; can sense the strength of people and buried objects, to about a hundred feet down
found a buried structure about eighty feet down, groundwater about four hundred paces off, a cave with ore, clay, Rock Mite tunnels and alchemical plants
senses a Creler nest about thirty feet down with at least two hundred infants (fourteen moving) and eggs; Ram says Demon-spawn go for people
put out an adventurers-wanted notice; pay is minimal per week plus a share of treasure, free food and lodging; no other Gold-rank team replied
bodyguards, Bismarck the Mossbear (not housebroken) with Frostwing on his back are at Riverfarm
will not kill Goblins; says Riverfarm is one of few places they can exist without being slaughtered, "not all Goblins are monsters"
tracks fleeing Crelers with his sense; fifteen remained plus eggs
offers new open-air baths powered by Revi's summoned creatures
owes Ryoka a party and gets a few RSVPs from nobles; Riverfarm is being readied for her guests
blind [Emperor] of the Unseen Empire; has "landsense" that Durene calls "[Emperor]-sense" and cannot read facial features or colours
rules some streets are "scare zones" at night and sends Hedag to speak to Oliyaya
recognises egg-drop soup and says he has not heard of rice, though Rie says it is Balerosian
Goblins caught stealing are ransomed at their body weight in ore
rebukes Rie for not briefing him and orders anything of note in Izril be directed to him
meet privately; Mavika sensed malice from Rie, and Eloise asks for Witches to be named beneficiaries of the pact and for land, "a small forest"
tests Rie with his ritual story while Typhenous sits outside and tugs his beard to signal Rie's truthfulness
plans to tell Tyrion the cure once found and let others deliver it
believes Rie may have tried to poison Lady Bethal Walchais and sent Wiskeria against the Goblins, per Ryoka's supposition
names Rie as the person who withheld the Circle's role in the poisoning
receives a delivered bottle of blue liquid distilled from the poisonous Amentus fruit, which she serves to guests
a [Lady] with [Sense Intentions] who can pin Ryoka in a chair with a skill; her hair is blonde and curled
orders a canister of ice cream shipped from the port city of Hazenbrad; it cost seventy gold coins, and she says it was invented a week ago by a master [Chef] in the northern continent
a [Lady]; says [Lady] has social skills that read intentions; she is sharper than her cheerful manner suggests

guesses Ryoka's origin among Terandia (the human continent), the Isles of Minos, the southeastern continent, the frozen archipelago, Gnoll tribes, Drake settlements, Antinium Colonies, Wistram and Dwarves
asks if Ryoka comes from any place in this world; afterwards arranges an expensive long-distance communication spell for privacy
has asked the Guild for Ryoka by name for days
visits Ryoka at The Rat's Tail in Celum, accompanied by head maid Ressa
calls herself a Lady of the Six Houses (via Ressa)
skill [Charming Demeanor] has no effect on Ryoka
offers a friend who can cast [Restoration] and other 4th Tier spells in exchange for answers to her questions
leaves a bronze medallion set with a sapphire; shattering the gem signals acceptance
refuses other Runner contracts until Ryoka delivers for her in person
knows Ryoka's character through her Skill and a mistake in not foreseeing the request
deliberately cheerful; uses an umbrella enchanted with [Water Resistance]; clears an inn and arrives with Ressa to find Ryoka's room empty
Yvlon's "aunt twice-removed"; she told her whole family to watch for Ryoka
knows about the [Assassin] Ryoka beat and the Carn Wolf fight
put a ninja on Ryoka's rooftop; Persua is a bully
rules House Reinhart and is among the ten most important people anywhere
argues with Teriarch in the north
always travels north for winter, now in Invrisil, the city of adventurers, six hundred miles north
says Ryoka has no skills, levels or class
shows Val a room of young people with bright clothes and a glowing flat device, newly arrived from Earth
knows Ryoka went south and says her answer is "nothing"
has many servants with high levels in unusual classes
heir to the Reinhart family and one of the richest on the continent
in her forties, shorter and larger than Ressa; shimmering green gown; serene, graceful; eyes like searchlights
head of the Reinhart family, heroine of the First Antinium War, loves ice cream and blue fruit juice
sitting room is predominantly pink
friendly, talkative, firm handshake; drinks a citrus tea that tastes of limes
learned chess at sixteen and has played one good opponent regularly since
wears an obsidian-rimmed monocle with runes; a friend made it; it reads Skills and Levels unless concealed
skill [Sense Intention] reveals which pieces her opponent is focusing on
uses [Charm] on the Earth-born to loosen their talk
says "Teriarch did say this would happen sooner or later"

says at least five people in the world could beat Erin: an old fool, the world's smallest strategist, a reclusive mage, a miserable king, a dashing charming lord; one genius on each continent except Chandrar
says the young Emperor and the King of Destruction's Left Hand are not good enough to beat Erin
wanted to confine the Earth-born so they could not cause harm; she says she found them because two groups had already been killed by monsters
says Earth weapons (guns, tanks, planes, bombs) in this world would end it; she will never create them unless another party spreads them first
says a "worldly confidant" and a few experts assure her it would take years to reproduce Earth technology
plans to send the Earth-born out as Bronze-rank adventurers with guides, not to let them die
calls the Antinium Queens her greatest nemeses; says the Antinium do not level and treat all soldiers equally
says in this world a single high-level hero can change a battle, so armies protect high levels
says guns would let the Antinium sweep the continent and the House of Minos fall to its ancient enemy within a decade
refers to "Klbkch the Slayer"
believes the Antinium Queens tried once to wipe out every living species and never made permanent peace
lists coming threats: the Isles of Minos closed to all ships, a Goblin Lord in the south, Az'kerash's army of the dead, Flos going to conquer
says war is coming, a "world war", and blames the arrival of Erin's people
knew Lyonette de Marquin, calls her dreadful, and chose to let her die rather than take her in
refuses to elaborate on where Ryoka is, calling her a gamble
says Erin is worth two Antinium Soldiers; Ryoka perhaps two dozen
